subject: [PATCH v2 05/10] mm/madvise: factor huge-PMD folio processing

2026-10-14.patch_summary: This patch refactors the handling of huge PMD folios in the madvise_lru_pmd_entry function by moving the checks and filtering into a new function called madvise_lru_huge_pmd_folio. This function returns NULL if there is nothing to do, allowing the caller to split the PMD lock before proceeding. The MADV_COLD young-bit clearing has also been moved into a separate function called madvise_cold_pmd. No functional changes are intended by this patch.
